title: Adequate Number of HDB Flats under Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme for Young Families
what_it_is: Adequate Number of HDB Flats under Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme for Young Families

sections.label: PPHS flats supply and demand
sections.summary: HDB has 680 PPHS flats, about 550 occupied, will add about 200 more by end-2021 for a total of about 880, and will monitor demand and review supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB has 680 PPHS flats presently, of which about 550 are occupied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB will be adding about 200 more flats by end-2021, bringing the total supply to about 880.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB will continue to monitor the demand and review the supply of PPHS flats, with a view to ensuring a small and steady supply of PPHS flats in the longer term.
